rows.definition: The LIVE forward-progress control plane over declared objectives (internal/trajctl, epic #2533): anything you want to progress gets a named objective and a witnessed score curve, and steering reads curves, never points
rows.distinction: Live progress of a declared objective - NOT fak traj (internal/trajectory + internal/trajhook, the RETROSPECTIVE corpus toolkit: trajhook scores a past turn's notability), NOT the scorecard family (repo-surface debt, not runs), NOT score-signal (the CI-regression feeder), NOT fak signal steer (one actuator rung trajctl uses), and NOT loopdrive's GOAL.md witness (the binary done-bit trajctl stretches into a curve)

rows.definition: One scored observation of one objective: normalized value, the scorer method+version that produced it, a witness rung, and an evidence pointer, appended to the fak-trajctl/1 JSONL ledger
rows.distinction: A live-objective progress observation - NOT a trajhook Finding (a worst-first notability flag on a PAST turn) and NOT a scorecard *_debt integer (a repo-surface fold with a CI ratchet)

rows.definition: The evidence-strength ladder every ScoreRow carries: W3 deterministic evidence (witnessed commit, green suite), W2 transcript-derived heuristic, W1 structured judge verdict, W0 self-report (recorded, never load-bearing); the read-time audit (witnessStrength) demotes a dangling W3 row to W0
rows.distinction: Grades a SCORE's evidence - NOT the witness/evidence family's world-state witness (refutes a cache entry) or measurement witness (proves an RSI gain), and NOT dispatchtick's WitnessOK (a resolution-corroboration constant)

rows.definition: The rule that HEALTHY means DO NOTHING: every steering rung above annotate fires only when the recent curve is unhealthy (STALL / DRIFT / DETOUR_OVERRUN), because intervening in a high-scoring session degrades it (arXiv:2602.03338); SignalHealthy is the gate's closed-vocabulary trigger
rows.distinction: Gates the CONTROLLER's own interventions on a live run - NOT an adjudication gate (no tool call is allowed or denied) and NOT a model gate (nothing neural); the dogfood run's HEALTHY -> withhold decision is this gate working

rows.definition: A side-quest promoted to a first-class CHILD objective with its own scorers and a budget, so an error repair or infra fix is scored on ITS goal while the parent sits visibly paused; SignalDetourOverrun fires when the detour outlives its budget
rows.distinction: A DECLARED child objective that must RETURN - NOT drift (declining alignment on the SAME objective: a detour is declared, drift is decay) and NOT a distraction to suppress (the detour's own score records whether the repair landed)
